Hello! I'm Bip, a reading robot.

But I have a problem. Listen to how I read.

I read like a robot. Every word sounds the same, and I never stop or ask or feel.

Four friends are going to help me.

Dotty is the full stop. Dotty says: stop!

Koma is the comma. Koma says: take a tiny breath.

Quizzy is the question mark. Quizzy says: ask!

Zing is the exclamation mark. Zing says: feel it!

With all four friends, I can read with feeling. Listen!

First, find your name and tap it.

If your teacher gave you secret pictures, tap your three pictures.

This is your home page, on Voice Island. Tap any friend to hear them.

These four chips are your reading skills. A chip lights up when you reach eighty percent.

Tap Continue, and I will take you to the best next step for you.

Follow your journey: Learn, then Practice, then the Reading Studio. The bars show how far you have gone.

Sing the chant here. It helps you remember the four voice rules.

Need help? Press Watch how on any page, or tap me in the corner to ask a question.

A full stop ends a telling sentence.

When you see Dotty, let your voice go down, and stop. Listen.

A comma is a short pause.

When you see Koma, take a tiny breath, then keep reading. Listen.

There are two kinds of questions.

A Yes or No question starts with words like do, is, can or are. Your voice goes up at the end.

A WH question starts with what, where, who, why, when or how. Start strong, and let your voice go down.

An exclamation mark shows a big feeling.

Read the story first. How does the person feel? Here, they are sad.

But here, the farmer is excited. Same words, different feeling!

Now open Learn. Tap a friend to start a lesson.

The poster reminds you what each mark tells your voice to do.

Each lesson has five small steps. First, meet your friend and listen.

Next, trace the mark with your finger. Stay on the light shape.

Then press Listen on each card, and hear how one mark changes the voice.

Find and tap every mark of that kind in the story.

Last, press Record and read the sentence yourself. I will give you tips. Then press Finish to earn three stars!
